title: Rabbi Chanan (a Tanna of a Baraita)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Sukkah 9b and 16a: “Rabbi Chanan said that Rabbi said.” In Megillah 14a he speaks in Rabbi Meir’s name. In Berakhot 56b: “Rabbi Chanan said: There are three [symbols of] peace: a river, a bird and a pot.” Rabbi Chanina said: “And we learned of a pot that has no meat in it.”
He is mentioned in Zuckermandel’s Tosefta at the end of Ohalot.
